# Workspace Instructions

- This is a React + TypeScript + Vite academic blog in Spanish.
- Keep the editorial layout responsive and accessible; use the existing CSS variables and components in `src/styles.css` and `src/App.tsx`.
- Blog posts and comments are stored in browser `localStorage`; there is no backend.
- Keep the public blog structure: header/navigation, chronological posts, categories, tags, blogroll, RSS, comments, and footer.
- Use `npm run dev` for local development and `npm run build` to validate production output.
